cohort: 65 pregnant women with GDM or pre-existing diabetes
finding: The study found a higher proportion of stillbirths, intrauterine deaths, and congenital malformations in the pre-existing diabetes group compared to the GDM group, though the difference was not statistically significant.
mod_finding: The study found a higher rate of Cesarean section in the GDM group (69.23%) compared to the pre-existing diabetes group (57.69%).
